Global_Event_Broadcast.message: Lyra Cinder to Seraphina Gilt: "Seraphina, a moment of your esteemed insight, if you please. With the recent... 'hiccup' at the press, I find myself pondering the ripples across the market. Particularly for certain, shall we say, more tempestuous compositions. How do you foresee this affecting the authenticity and valuation of, for instance, the 'Thunderstorm' sheets?"
Marius Gilt to Valerius Gilt: "The press jam is now suspected sabotage. What do you know about the foreign spore, Valerius? Your previous evasiveness is concerning."

Seraphina Gilt to Valerius Gilt: "Valerius, I couldn't help but notice the… unique patina on these brass folios. As an Atmospheric Sommelier, I pride myself on discerning the genuine from the... inspired. May I have a closer look? The 'High-Altitude Mist' tasting requires an impeccable standard, after all."

Valerius Gilt to Seraphina Gilt: "Seraphina, have you heard anything more about that unfortunate incident at the Weather Sheet Music Press? Such a disruption to the rain cycle... one almost wonders if it was entirely accidental."
Vespera Thorne used Coordinate on Kestrel Reed.
Silas Vane used Coordinate on Kaelen Moss.
